# HDXCLOUD

HDXCLOUD is a hosting brand offering Minecraft hosting and VPS / VM hosting.

Official website: https://www.hdxclouds.com
Client billing panel: https://billing.hdxcloud.xyz
VPS / VM panel: https://vms.hdxclouds.com
Documentation and policies: https://docs.hdxclouds.info

## Minecraft Hosting

Three Minecraft hosting tiers, each priced per GB of RAM per month:

1. Cheap Plan — ₹10 per GB of RAM per month. CPU: Intel Xeon E5-2620 v4.
2. Budget Plan — ₹20 per GB of RAM per month. CPU: Intel Xeon 6.
3. Performance Plan — ₹30 per GB of RAM per month. CPU: AMD EPYC 9755 or Intel Core Ultra 9, depending on the hosting node assigned.

All plans include SSD storage. Online RAM selections support 1 GB to 32 GB.

Requests above 32 GB of RAM are handled through a Discord support ticket once the official invite is published.
